program: RH/Weil information comparison at n = 4 — Candidate A
numeric_warrant: E1 — every number quoted is a certified enclosure
subject: 4x4 even Weil block {1, b, b^2, b^3} on [log 3, log 4]

raw_determinant.note: ~1e-19 pointwise against O(1e-1) entries: five to six more orders of collapse beyond n = 3, of which the invariant gap accounts for barely one -- the rest is the coordinate system again

conditioning.preconditioned: O(1) diagonal under the frozen dyadic congruence

questions.do_the_moments_force_the_inertia: NO -- already false at n = 3 (ENG-008), and the moment map is even less injective at n = 4
questions.do_the_moments_constrain_the_generalized: only trivially: m1..m4 are basis-dependent traces of G alone and carry no information about the pencil (G, M) beyond crude bounds; nothing here improves on the shifted covers
questions.is_the_generalized_gap_still_the_best_cr: YES, and more clearly than at n = 3: the raw determinant lost another five-plus orders to coordinates, while the gap both measured the real decay (~15x) and located a bottleneck at the right cell edge that no raw quantity showed
questions.did_rank_trace_become_more_or_less_infor: less: the bound weakens with dimension (rank >= 1 against a true rank of 4)
